items.title: The Pink Line is open
items.body: Maan to District Court, with 17 of 23 stations open. First trains leave both ends at 06:00.

items.title: Six Pink Line stations are still closed
items.body: Balewadi High Street and Balewadi Phata are expected by end of November. Baner Gaon, Baner Pashan Link Road, Bhosalenagar - RBI and Shivaji Nagar are expected in phases by January 2027.

items.title: The Pink Line needs its own ticket
items.body: Trips between the Pink Line and the Purple or Aqua Line use two QR tickets. The official app sells both in one payment.
items.source: Pune Metro official app release notes

items.title: Save with One Pune cards
items.body: The One Pune NCMC card gives 10% off every ride. The One Pune Vidyarthi Pass gives students 30% off.

items.title: Pune Metro tickets on Uber and Paytm
items.body: Both apps sell Pune Metro QR tickets through ONDC, alongside the official app and WhatsApp booking.

items.title: Official fares and timings
items.body: Journeys now show the fare from the official Maha Metro and Puneri Metro fare charts, including two-ticket trips. Pink Line timings come from Puneri Metro's official time table, and Purple and Aqua service hours from Maha Metro.
